== Biography ==

The Queen is the ruler of the field mice, referred to as "Queen of the Mice" and "Queen of the Field Mice." She speaks in a small, squeaky voice. After the Tin Woodman killed a Wildcat that had been chasing her, she thanked him for saving her life, and her mice subjects rushed to check on her safety, bowing low before her. When Dorothy and her companions later lost their way in a field, the Queen and her mice came running to help; she told Dorothy the direction of the Emerald City and revealed that the Golden Cap Dorothy carried held a charm to summon the Winged Monkeys, warning that the Monkeys were mischievous and that the mice would need to flee before the charm was used.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — friend. Their repeated encounters suggest a friendly bond, though the text never states this outright.

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — ally. Their shared travels alongside Dorothy suggest a cooperative relationship.

'''[[Tin Woodman]]''' — ally. The Woodman killed the Wildcat that was chasing her, which suggests a grateful, allied bond, though this reading remains an inference rather than an explicit statement.

'''[[Toto]]''' — acquaintance. The mice's wary request that Toto not harm them suggests only a brief, cautious acquaintance.
